run_inference_text_to_video: run inference on a dataset file to generate text-to-video outputs using a pretrained model
run_inference_text_to_image: run inference on a dataset file to generate text-to-image outputs using a pretrained model
run_inference_image_to_video: run inference on a dataset file to generate image-to-video outputs using a pretrained model
run_inference_with_parallel: run inference with context parallelism and attention provider configuration for distributed generation
run_inference_with_compile: run inference with torch.compile on specified pipeline modules for accelerated generation
